newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Urban sets 5 peso cash dividend, 15 pct stock dividend.
newsitem.headline: Urban sets 5 peso cash dividend, 15 pct stock dividend.

text.p: Urban Bank Corp said on Thursday its board had approved a resolution declaring a five peso cash dividend and a 15 percent stock dividend.
The bank told the Philippine Stock Exchange that stockholders as of March 31 will be eligible for the cash dividend.
The details for the stock dividend are still being worked out pending the approval of its shareholders and the Central Bank.
